name: Microsoft PyRIT
note: Added a memory-backed dataset summary API (#2762, 11 files, with tests) for PyRIT's planned dataset explorer, then four fixes: XInclude-based XXE detection, an empty-string false positive in exact text matching, HarmBench context strings being dropped, and converter identifiers that collided across word-selection strategies.

name: Inspect AI
kind: UK AI Security Institute's LLM evaluation framework
note: With GOOGLE_USE_ADC set, Inspect sent every Gemini call through ambient credentials even when you passed an API key. Now an explicit key wins unless ADC is chosen for that model (#5670, fixes #5358).

name: aios
note: A streaming trailer could overwrite finish_reason="length", hiding truncated output. I kept the signal through stream assembly (#2457), recorded it as truncation telemetry on the step span (#2458), made timeouts say whether the deadline or the spend ceiling fired (#2459), and stopped a passthrough from bypassing LiteLLM's parameter translation (#2460).
